description: Count accounts opened inside the window, excluding any opened exactly at either endpoint.

d.request: Count accounts in `Accounts` where `date_account_opened` (compared as text) is strictly greater than '2011-03-29 15:06:59' and strictly less than '2015-02-02 09:47:08'.
d.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM Accounts WHERE CAST(date_account_opened AS TEXT) > '2011-03-29 15:06:59' AND CAST(date_account_opened AS TEXT) < '2015-02-02 09:47:08';

b.request: Count accounts in `Accounts` where `date_account_opened` (compared as text) is strictly greater than '2011-03-29 15:06:59' and strictly less than '2015-02-02 09:47:08'.
b.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Accounts WHERE date_account_opened > '2011-03-29 15:06:59' AND date_account_opened < '2015-02-02 09:47:08';
b.raw: Count accounts in `Accounts` where `date_account_opened` (compared as text) is strictly greater than '2011-03-29 15:06:59' and strictly less than '2015-02-02 09:47:08'.

c.request: How many accounts were opened between '2011-03-29 15:06:59' and '2015-02-02 09:47:08' (compare `date_account_opened` as text)? Count accounts opened inside the window, excluding any opened exactly at either endpoint.
c.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts FROM Accounts WHERE date_account_opened > '2011-03-29 15:06:59' AND date_account_opened < '2015-02-02 09:47:08';

a.request: How many accounts were opened strictly after '2011-03-29 15:06:59' and strictly before '2015-02-02 09:47:08', both endpoints excluded, comparing `date_account_opened` as text?
a.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts FROM Accounts WHERE CAST(date_account_opened AS TEXT) > '2011-03-29 15:06:59' AND CAST(date_account_opened AS TEXT) < '2015-02-02 09:47:08';
